rules: Always alias 'desc' as 'play_description' when querying play_by_play to avoid reserved keyword errors.
Do NOT look for 'game_id' in weekly_stats; games are identified by (season, week, team).
Defensive fantasy points allowed must be aggregated from play_by_play grouped by defteam, never from weekly_stats.
Always filter out non-plays when calculating efficiency or EPA: WHERE qb_kneel = 0 AND qb_spike = 0.
Use ILIKE '%Name%' for all fuzzy player and team name searches.
